summary: Iteration 92 — Three P0 backend fixes verified via /app/backend/tests/iteration92_pos_p0_fixes_test.py. 29/29 checks PASS. FIX 1 (new_or_existing stamping + backfill), FIX 2 (non-OTP posRedeemPointRequest idempotency guard), FIX 3 (pre-tax earn base for both POS payload styles + inclusive/exclusive/auto modes) are all correct end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: pos_ewards_routes.py:1817 — new_or_existing logic uses prev_visits==0 as the 'new' predicate. Correct because visit_count is $inc'd only in _apply_bill_credit which runs AFTER txn_doc is built, so prev_visits is always the pre-bill state. Would benefit from a one-line comment reference to _apply_bill_credit ordering so future refactors don't accidentally move the visit_count increment above the txn_doc build.

pos_ewards_routes.py:1109-1146 — non-OTP redemption uses an atomic upsert claim keyed by (type,reference_type,reference_id=bill_number). Correct and MongoDB-compatible without multi-doc transactions. Consider adding a unique index on (type=redeem, reference_type=transaction, reference_id) to make the guard a hard DB-level constraint (currently relies on the $setOnInsert semantic). Also, the bill-less fallback (line 1153-1171) still has no dedupe — a POS retry without a bill_number could double-deduct. Low-risk since KAZO POS always sends bill numbers, but worth documenting.

kpi_matrix_routes.py:_compute_new_or_existing — the two-step approach (set all→existing, then flip earliest→new) is safe under scoping via `mobile` filter but on a FULL 1.5M-row unscoped run the initial update_many + aggregation without deadline could exceed the 1800s pymongo.timeout; consider chunking by mobile prefix.

_earn_base auto-detect uses `abs(base - (net_val + tax_gst)) <= max(1.0, base * 0.01)` — 1% tolerance is generous; ensure rounding differences on POS side don't accidentally trigger the inclusive path for pre-tax payloads that happen to have a stray net_amount field.
